  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

  SPECIAL MEETING

 CALL TO ORDER

 At 3:07 PM, Mayor Richardson called the meeting to order.

 ROLL CALL

 Councilmembers Present: Zendejas, Duggan, Kerr, Saro, Uranga, Ricks-Oddie

 Councilmembers Absent: Allen, Supernaw, Austin

 Also present: Thomas Modica, City Manager, April Walker, Assistant City Manager, Atoy Wilson,
 Deputy City Attorney, Jonathan Nagayama, City Clerk Analyst.

 Mayor Richardson presiding.

 STUDY SESSION

 1.  24-52536  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation on the City’s Fiscal Outlook
  and FY 25 Proposed Budget Development Update.

  A motion was made by Councilwoman Kerr, seconded by Councilmember
  Ricks-Oddie, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the
  following vote:

  Yes:  6  Zendejas, Duggan, Kerr, Saro, Uranga, Ricks-Oddie
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Absent: 3  Allen, Supernaw, Austin

  Mayor Richardson spoke.
